statement.notes: The primary statement provides a single line item for 'Depreciation of property and equipment' under the adjustments to reconcile net income. This is the standard component for depreciation and amortization in the cash flow statement for a technology company like Alphabet. No separate amortization line is presented, suggesting it may be included within this line or may be immaterial. The supplementary tables provide details on lease accounting but do not break out separate depreciation/amortization amounts for lease assets that would be additive to the primary statement line.
